subject: mth
title: MTH.------EXT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 435 (MID-W-29). MTH (methodology) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names EXT-F (extended functionalism); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From AFL-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From PROG-CONT: TRS (transition). From ACC-DY: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: VT-S (vibrational science). From VT-S: RE-ST (restructuralism) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: MTA-IMP (meta-implications).
